Rule.name: fixed-mar-03
Rule.comment: Proclaimed by the United Nations in 2013 and first observed on 3 March 2014, the date of the 1973 signing of CITES.

Rule.name: fixed-may-20
Rule.comment: Designated by the United Nations in 2017 and first observed in 2018. The date marks the birthday of Anton Janša, a pioneer of modern beekeeping.

Rule.name: fixed-jul-29
Rule.comment: Established at the Saint Petersburg Tiger Summit in 2010 to raise awareness of tiger conservation.

Rule.name: fixed-aug-08
Rule.comment: An international cat welfare observance created by the International Fund for Animal Welfare and now associated with cat welfare and responsible care awareness.

Rule.name: fixed-aug-12
Rule.comment: Founded in 2012 by Patricia Sims and the Elephant Reintroduction Foundation to draw attention to the critical status of both Asian and African elephants.

Rule.name: fixed-aug-26
Rule.comment: An international companion-animal observance that celebrates dogs, promotes adoption and responsible ownership, and recognizes working and assistance dogs.

Rule.name: fixed-oct-04
Rule.comment: Originated at a congress of ecologists in Florence in 1931. The date coincides with the Feast of Saint Francis of Assisi, patron saint of animals.
